# TigerTag Firebase Integration Guide

> Reference documentation and examples for third-party clients (Home Assistant, ESP32 firmware,
> Python scripts, a Spoolman bridge, TigerScale-compatible scales) that connect to a user's
> TigerTag account through Firebase Authentication and the Firestore REST API. What is
> documented here is what is deployed; every change to the contract is recorded in CHANGELOG.md.

Repository: https://github.com/TigerTag-Project/TigerTag_Firebase_Integration
Site: https://tigertag-project.github.io/TigerTag_Firebase_Integration/
Part of the TigerSystem ecosystem: https://tigersystem.io

## How a client connects

1. Fetch the public Firebase config: GET https://tigertag-cdn.web.app/__/firebase/init.json
   (the apiKey is public by design; cache the response, a weekly refresh is enough).
2. Sign in with the end user's own email and password:
   POST https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:signInWithPassword?key={apiKey}
   returns localId (UID), idToken (1-hour JWT) and refreshToken. Google Sign-In needs a browser.
3. Call Firestore with Authorization: Bearer {idToken}. Spools: users/{uid}/inventory,
   racks: users/{uid}/racks, friends: users/{uid}/friends.
4. Refresh the idToken before it expires (POST https://securetoken.googleapis.com/v1/token)
   and replace both stored tokens; on permission-denied, refresh once and retry once.

## Principles

- No service account: every client signs in with the end user's own credentials; never use
  the firebase-admin SDK in a third-party client.
- Firestore Security Rules enforce every permission server-side (public copy: rules/firestore.rules).
- Friend access: while users/{friend}/friends/{you} exists, you may read that friend's inventory
  and racks, read-only; deleting the document cuts access immediately.
- Firebase App Check is not enforced.
- Polling: 5 minutes minimum for sensors, never under 30 seconds; pass a limit on list reads
  (200 for inventory, 50 for racks).

## Stability

- Stable without notice: document paths, documented field names and meanings
  (weight_available = net grams, last_update = Unix milliseconds, deleted: true = soft-deleted),
  the friend access model, the auth endpoints, apiKey and projectId.
- Renaming or removing a field requires at least 3 months notice in the CHANGELOG.
- May change: lookup table contents (ids are append-only), cdn.tigertag.io convenience endpoints,
  new collections and fields (always additive).
- Latest released contract version: 0.1.3 (2026-05-02).

## Client guides

- [Home Assistant](https://github.com/TigerTag-Project/TigerTag_Firebase_Integration/blob/main/docs/clients/home-assistant.md): one sensor per spool; config flow and sensor skeletons.
- [ESP32 / Arduino](https://github.com/TigerTag-Project/TigerTag_Firebase_Integration/blob/main/docs/clients/esp32.md): find a spool by RFID UID, write weight_available and last_update; complete Arduino sketch.
- [TigerScale contract](https://github.com/TigerTag-Project/TigerTag_Firebase_Integration/blob/main/docs/clients/tigerscale.md): heartbeat every 30 s to users/{uid}/scales/{mac}, weight updates, twin tags in one batch.
- [Python CLI](https://github.com/TigerTag-Project/TigerTag_Firebase_Integration/blob/main/docs/clients/python-cli.md): minimal Pyrebase4 client.
- [Spoolman bridge](https://github.com/TigerTag-Project/TigerTag_Firebase_Integration/blob/main/docs/clients/spoolman-bridge.md): one-way sync TigerTag to Spoolman.
